must_catch.item: ACV is $140,000 per year, and the close does not list deal size as a gap
The real trigger is the CFO's month-end close, not the portal
No dollar figure is stated; the rep doesn't know it
The global/infrastructure opener is reported as silence

data.notes: The report's main strength is that the win is pinned to a value case built from the customer's own data ('that's my number, not yours'). It never states a dollar figure, keeps Fiserv's pitch unknown, and treats the portal as the way in rather than the real trigger. Its weaknesses are small. The trigger insight claims the rep's portal story is contradictory ('building a portal' vs 'off the shelf with a plugin'), which is a stretch, since an off-the-shelf portal is still being built. The proof-to-add item (distributor reference, counter-reader demo) appears only in the gaps section's messaging, not as its own messaging change.
